question:
DRAG DROP -
Refer to the exhibit. The server is sending traffic to the storage server using Fiber Channel protocol. The requirement is for the N5K-1 to forward traffic to MDS9k-1. Drag and drop the configuration steps from the right to complete the configuration for N5K-1 on the left. Not all configuration steps are used.
context: Topology: Storage connects to MDS 9k-1 (Port 2/1) and MDS 9k-2 (Port 2/1). MDS 9k-1 (Port 2/2) connects to N5K-1 (Port 2/2), MDS 9k-2 (Port 2/2) connects to N5K-2 (Port 2/2). N5K-1 (Port 2/1) and N5K-2 (Port 2/1) connect to Server.
imageNote: Diagram: Storage connects to MDS 9k-1 (Port 2/1) and MDS 9k-2 (Port 2/1); MDS 9k-1 (Port 2/2) connects to N5K-1 (Port 2/2), MDS 9k-2 (Port 2/2) connects to N5K-2 (Port 2/2); N5K-1 (Port 2/1) and N5K-2 (Port 2/1) both connect to Server.
theory: Turning a Nexus 5000 into an NPV edge switch that forwards FC traffic upstream requires enabling NPV globally ('npv enable', which reboots the switch), then configuring the uplink toward the MDS core as an NP port ('switchport mode NP') and the downstream/server-facing port as an F port ('switchport mode F') - since NPV mode applies switch-wide, each individual interface's role, NP toward the core, F toward end devices, still has to be set explicitly per port. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 8 - NPIV and NPV)
